name: European Central Bank
summary: ECB Data Portal SDMX API: euro reference exchange rates, ECB interest rates, inflation, money and banking statistics, keyless.
notes: Data is addressed by dataflow (e.g. EXR, exchange rates) and a series key: dimension codes in the dataflow's order joined by dots, e.g. EXR + D.USD.EUR.SP00.A (daily USD per EUR reference rate).
In a key, an empty position is a wildcard (D..EUR.SP00.A = every currency) and + is OR (D.USD+JPY.EUR.SP00.A).
The default response is SDMX-ML XML; pass format=jsondata for SDMX-JSON or format=csvdata for CSV.
Find dataflows with ecb.dataflows and a dataflow's dimensions and codes with ecb.datastructure (references=children).

endpoints.name: Get time series data
endpoints.summary: Observations of every series in a dataflow matching a series key, filtered by period.

key.description: Series key; empty positions wildcard, + for OR.

startPeriod.description: Start period: YYYY, YYYY-S1, YYYY-Q1, YYYY-MM, YYYY-W01 or YYYY-MM-DD by frequency.

lastNObservations.description: Only the N most recent observations per series.

firstNObservations.description: Only the N first observations per series.

updatedAfter.description: ISO 8601 timestamp; only observations added, revised or deleted since then.

detail.description: full (default) data and attributes; dataonly without attributes; serieskeysonly lists matching series only; nodata series and attributes without observations.

includeHistory.description: Also return previous versions of the data; default false.

notes: A whole dataflow with no key can be very large and slow; always give a key.
detail=serieskeysonly lists the series a wildcard key matches without the data.

endpoints.name: List dataflows
endpoints.summary: Every dataflow (dataset) the ECB publishes, with names.

detail.description: allstubs returns only id, agency, version and name.

endpoints.name: Get a dataflow's structure
endpoints.summary: Dimensions of a data structure definition and, with references=children, the codelists for each dimension.

references.description: Also return related artefacts; children adds the codelists and concept schemes used.

endpoints.name: Get a codelist
endpoints.summary: Codes and labels of one codelist (e.g. CL_FREQ, the frequency codes).
